RETICLE GUIDE
Center dot: aim point · Weapon silhouette: current spread · Faint inner ticks: aimed spread
Sight range warning: amber means reduced damage · Red means out of range
Outer arc: magazine · One stroke: single · Multiple strokes: burst count · Chevrons: automatic
A full gold ring readies the next critical shot · Double slashes confirm a hit
Reload or charge morphs the magazine arc into a progress ring · Sight edges warm up on firing
